material_finding: The canonical recorder assigns received_ms at REST response processing time for every fetched trade. A backfill therefore compresses historical market activity into a few receive-time instants. received_ms is valid for causal information availability and ordering, but not by itself for measuring an execution-window market flow rate.

broader_tape_diagnostic.note: This ratio is descriptive on the current 189-row tape and is not a fill-probability estimate.

required_successor_contract: Use received_ms only to establish what information was causally available to the decision and to order observations as they become known.

For forward fill credit require both causal receipt after order arrival and an exchange/event timestamp after order arrival and within the execution deadline; do not credit old backfilled trades.
Keep queue/depth/fee/target snapshots point-in-time and combine dual-clock flow with joint per-leg states plus partial-fill abort/unwind economics.
Re-run common chronological Graph/RV and repaired Local Factor execution experiments before using completion or fill-conditioned PnL for promotion.
